configuration.sensorOrientation: OMNIBUSF4 uses CW180, while REVO uses CW270 in the same upstream coordinate convention. With Revolution's PiOS TOP180 transform, BoardRotation yaw -90 degrees produces the corresponding HGLRC body axes.
configuration.osd: SPI3 slave 0 is MAX7456 on PA15; select MAX7456 OSD instead of the original Revolution radio.
configuration.magnetometer: The board has no onboard magnetometer; select None.
configuration.motorTimer: Motor 3 uses PA3 with TIM9 CH2 in PiOS and TIM2 CH4 in Betaflight. Both are STM32F405 alternate functions for PA3; the other three motor pins and timer channels match.
configuration.storage: Revolution probes supported JEDEC capacities on PB3 and uses its internal settings partition when no supported external flash responds.
configuration.usb: Revolution revision 3 uses the same PC5 VBUS sense input; USB telemetry is enabled by default. Missing original barometer/magnetometer hardware is handled by the clone initializer.
